trello.name: Send final DataBridge renewal email and escalate to legal if needed
trello.desc: Sofia sends one final email today in plain language requesting revised renewal terms from DataBridge by Thursday close of business. If no reply is received by Thursday COB, Sofia escalates to legal on Friday morning to review termination-for-convenience options without waiting for Ravi's approval. The contract lapses August 29th.

trello.name: Request Dana to review security audit sections 4 and 6
trello.desc: Sofia messages Dana today, framing it as a request from Ravi, asking her to review sections 4 and 6 of the 60-page external security audit report covering cryptography and key management findings. Dana should send her assessment to this group before the next sync in two weeks. If Dana lacks bandwidth, Ravi will take the request to her manager.

trello.name: Update rebrand FAQ with logo decision
trello.desc: Tomas adds a line to the rebrand FAQ stating the March decision that the logo stays as is and only the color palette changes, with a link to the March meeting notes. To be completed this week so the logo question stops resurfacing every quarter.
